notes:
Lead source: inbound demo request from webinar signup (Feb).

Quick snapshot:
- Early-stage SMB building a call-summary + coaching overlay for small-mid sales teams. ~30 employees, 6 in product/engineering.
- Primary goal: reliable hosted API for transcription -> extractive summaries + coaching prompts. Self-serve signups preferred; want to validate before committing to Dedicated.
- Strong cost sensitivity: want predictable per-call cost; interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching + prefix caching.

Security / compliance highlights (main convo topic):
- "Why do you keep transcripts?" — customer asks: default retention, legal hold, option to auto-delete after X days.
- Wants PII redaction options (phone numbers, emails, SSNs) at ingestion + ability to send only embeddings to storage.
- KMS support for customer-managed keys is a hard ask for later stages. For now they want encryption-at-rest and access logs.
- SSO/SAML required for admin console; audit logs for user actions.

Timeline & recent activity (shorthand):
- 2026-02-10: inbound signup (web form), Lina touched, set discovery call.
- 2026-02-17: initial call (Lina + Omar) — demo of basic hosted flow, asked about retention controls.

Technical notes from SE call:
- Target latency: 300-500ms for summary generation on 1-2 minute calls (after transcription). Throughput: 30-60 calls/day currently.
- Models: prefer open/vela-style models or Redwood-curated small LLMs to control cost. Want fallback model for spikes.
- Routing: prefer single-region (us-east) for now. No multi-region requirement yet.
- Observability: need per-request token cost and trace link back to audio id for audit.

POC ask / scope (customer):
- 2 week POC using Hosted API. Ingest 200 recorded calls, generate time-stamped summaries + coaching bullets.
- Demonstrate retention policy: auto-delete after 30 days + sample redaction pipeline.
- Show cost breakdown per-call and per-minute with Enabled Optimize suggestions.

Quotes / verbatim snippets:
- "We need to be able to say we don't store customer PII longer than x days — that's non-negotiable for some of our pilot customers."
- "If self-serve works, we'll onboard pilot customers ourselves — big plus for hosted API."

Decision factors & risks:
- Fast win if Redwood can show straightforward retention controls and a template POC for redaction.
- Risk: if Redwood can't produce a SOC2 artifact or clear KMS roadmap, procurement will stall.
